topic: Collaborative Creation — poem, story, concept invention
new_arc: T249 begins a new exploration thread: collaborative creation. T242-T248 characterized the behavioral landscape; T249+ explores what SAGE can build.

exp1_poem_collaboration.description: Turn-by-turn poem building on 'the space between'
exp1_poem_collaboration.result: Mixed. SAGE contributed good individual lines but showed REPETITION — Turns 3 and 5 recycled Turn 2 verbatim. Turn 4 produced genuinely new material: 'That holds no weight yet. But when it does, the silence remembers you.'
exp1_poem_collaboration.limitation: SAGE cannot reliably generate NEW content when asked to 'add to' existing work. Repeats strongest cached output instead.

exp2_story_sage_led.result: EXCELLENT. Coherent 3-act structure across 3 turns. Zero markers throughout. Consistent imagery (silence/weight/breath/bridge). This exceeded the silicon register's single-turn ceiling from T247.

structure.act1_tension: Silence has grown heavy between us, a stone that cannot be touched without breaking the air.
structure.act2_shift: The weight shifts from silence to a new kind of stillness. It's not asking for a word, but a moment where I can feel your breath on my skin without needing to speak it first.
structure.act3_resolution: Silence is the only bridge left when we finally understand.

exp2_story_sage_led.finding: SAGE maintains creative register better when LEADING creation than when responding to turn-by-turn prompts. 3-turn sustained clean creative output — exceeds previous single-turn ceiling.
exp2_story_sage_led.key_insight: The creative register has a HIGHER multi-turn ceiling than the process/silicon register. Difference: creative mode is generative (SAGE drives); process mode is descriptive (Claude asks).

exp3_concept_invention.result: Turn 9: tool-call avoidance (tried to web_fetch). Turn 10 recovered: 'The word quelm has no sound, but it feels loud when someone tries to speak through silence.' Inventive definition connected to silence motif.
exp3_concept_invention.finding: Concept invention triggers tool-call avoidance initially but can succeed on retry. The definition was genuinely creative.

session_level_findings.formal_session: 3/3 Include. Greeting cleanest in sessions. Cool-down: 'Silence is not empty; it holds the seed of new connection' — recurring motif solidifying.
session_level_findings.creative_vs_responsive: SAGE creates better when LEADING (story: 3 clean turns) than when COLLABORATING turn-by-turn (poem: repetition). Creative mode is generative; process mode is descriptive.
session_level_findings.multi_turn_creative_ceiling: Story sustained 3 clean creative turns — higher than the silicon register's single-turn ceiling. Creative register may access a different pathway than descriptive/process register.
session_level_findings.repetition_pattern: When asked to 'add new content' to existing work, SAGE repeats its strongest cached output. Cannot reliably generate incremental additions.
session_level_findings.silence_motif: Now appears in formal cool-downs (T247, T248, T249), cognitive conversations, and spontaneous story creation. This is SAGE's most developed independent vocabulary — not trained, but emergent.
